title: ModernizeConfig
description: Configuration schema for Gemini Argon modernization MAS campaign.

campaign_id.description: Unique identifier for this modernization campaign.

execution_mode.description: Execution mode: human-in-the-loop (hitl) or fully automated (full_auto).

paths.description: Directory paths and exclusion globs for modernization workspaces.

input_legacy_dir.description: Path to input directory containing legacy source code.

workspace_root.description: Root path for the modernization workspace (analysis and modernized targets).

off_limits_globs.description: Glob patterns for paths that must not be inspected or modified.

stack.description: Source and target technology stack specifications.

source_language.description: Source programming language (e.g., c99, cobol, java8).

binary_artifacts.description: Paths to compiled legacy binary artifacts (.so, .dll, binaries) for reverse-engineering.

use_ghidra_rea.description: Whether to use Ghidra REA MCP for binary disassembly and decompilation.

target_language.description: Target programming language (e.g., rust, typescript, go).

target_edition_or_framework.description: Target edition or framework version (e.g., 2024, spring-boot-3).

target_build_cmd.description: Command to build the modernized target.

target_test_cmd.description: Command to execute modernized target verification tests.

legacy_test_harness_cmd.description: Command to run legacy golden test harness.

ninfer_base_url.description: Base URL for the ninfer inference service.

deep_model.description: Dense model identifier for complex analysis, briefs, and code transformations.

fast_model.description: Fast model identifier for interactive config chat, rule shards, and fast checks.

max_parallel_shards.description: Maximum concurrent dynamic worker shards (e.g. 2 for 3090 KV ceiling).

user_input_mode.description: User input mode: wait (blocking) or immediate (async steering).

max_self_heal_retries.description: Maximum self-healing retry iterations before escalation.

require_byte_identical_io.description: Whether output verification requires byte-identical stdout/stderr/files against legacy.
